rows.text: In the Rajya Sabha on 5 August 1997 Shri Joyanta Roy (West Bengal) said that 'as President of the Janata Dal, Shri Laloo Prasad Yadav had taken active part in the formation of the Common Minimum Programme of the United Front Government'.

locator.section: speech of Shri Joyanta Roy (West Bengal)

rows.text: In the same discussion Shri Som Pal said: 'Now, the President of the JD has been formally charge-framed by the court. Would my friends not demand the JD being out of the United Front Government?'
